identity: A very short modern-MSA opinion paragraph: 35 tokens, one paragraph, no <NL> at all. It claims social media are the most important channel of communication between family and society, then shifts to naming example apps. The register is unpolished and non-professional: وقد تكون تأثيرا أهم من المجتمع is grammatically loose (تأثيرا floating as an accusative), and مثل الأسرة أو عمل تطوعي dangles as an afterthought whose reference is unclear. This reads as a student composition or a short blog/forum post, not edited journalism. Doctrine genre C (modern essay / op-ed) in its plainest, shortest form. Explicitly NOT any of my list-shaped genres: no cataphoric announcer, no items on their own lines, no headings, no ordinals, no parallel siblings without connectives, no verse, no legal article structure. Genre is settled before segmenting, per checklist item 1.
law: Master Law §0: the unit is an information chunk, roughly one finite predication. Every و and every ف is decided by the conjunct-weight test — if what follows carries its own predication (finite verb, its own fronted topic, its own frame) it OPENS a new unit; if it is a bare noun, adjective or exemplifier phrase hanging off the previous predicate, it stays inside. مثل + NP is a bare exemplifier: never a boundary, and its members are never split from one another (bare-noun و/أو). A ≤5-word, non-parallel, dependent-feeling tail is absorbed by the neighbour that governs it (0b). The paragraph-final token always closes a unit. Under this law the paragraph is three chunks: the thesis, the comparative expansion, and the applications topic-shift.
reasoning: Six candidate sites; two real cuts plus the mandatory final one. @9 والمجتمع — the و inside بين الأسرة والمجتمع joins two bare nouns under one predicate; conjunct-weight returns bare-NP, NO CUT (§0, A2). @13 الدول, before وقد — CUT, high confidence, doubly licensed: وقد is an explicit CUT entry (F4), and the conjunct تكون تأثيرا أهم من المجتمع carries its own finite verb, so A1/C1 apply independently. Per B8/D2 I looked for an earlier competing boundary and found none: في كل أنحاء الدول is a bare PP adjunct with no predication of its own, so it closes out the إن-clause rather than opening anything, and there is no rival connective within five words. Tail check (0b): the unit thus opened runs eleven words to تطوعي, far above the ≤5 threshold, so the brake does not fire. @19 المجتمع, before مثل الأسرة أو عمل تطوعي — NO CUT. مثل is a preposition-like exemplifier, not a connective; it is also not a cataphoric announcer, because H1 requires a stem that ends mid-construction with parallel items following, whereas here تكون تأثيرا أهم من المجتمع is already complete and the items ride inside the sentence. The fragment is five words, bare NP, non-parallel and dependent, so 0b absorbs it, and its internal أو is bare-noun أو (I5). @24 تطوعي, before وأما — THE HARD SITE. I CUT, at medium confidence, and I am knowingly overriding a written row of my own doctrine. F5 and the §2 table say أما X فـ Y attaches to its antecedent. That row rests on exactly one instance, doc_405d5fba81e0 @766 (أما أسجارد والآلهة فلم تكن كذلك), and that very same instance is also logged in my short-tail table at 0b, five words. The two entries are one piece of evidence counted twice: the observed attachment there is fully explained by the short-tail brake and tells me nothing intrinsic about أما. Here the brake cannot fire — وأما تطبيقاتها فيكون تأثيرها كبيرا مثل واتساب سنابتشات أو إنستجرام is ten words, double the threshold. Everything else converges on CUT: it is و plus a new finite predication (A1/C1); it is a topic-comment frame with its own fronted topic تطبيقاتها and the apodosis-ف riding on فيكون, which is as strong a new-frame signal as this register produces; it is a genuine topic shift from social media in general to its applications specifically; and it is the third connective in the stretch, which 0c says is almost always a boundary. Checklist item 4 binds me here too — the default is CUT and I must actively justify not cutting, because my prior is 7:1 wrong in the merge direction. I mark it med rather than hi solely because I am contradicting an explicit table row; on the linguistics alone I would call it hi. @29 كبيرا, before مثل واتساب — NO CUT, identical to @19. I also refuse to split واتساب سنابتشات أو إنستجرام internally: checklist item 3 (three-plus parallel siblings equals a list) is aimed at option banks and drill lines, which have no connective and sit on their own lines (I4, J1). Here three brand names ride inside a prose sentence, governed by مثل and joined by أو — precisely the J5 pattern that merges. @34 إنستجرام — final token, boundary by format rule. Result: three units averaging about twelve tokens, consistent with prose density across batch 1.
